# Included Superpowers references

Source: local installed openai-curated-remote/superpowers 6.3.0.
Upstream: https://github.com/obra/superpowers

The five SKILL.md files are unmodified copies. Only directly useful supporting references are included; authoring logs, skill pressure-test exercises and Codex-specific agents/openai.yaml metadata are omitted. This is a curated reference subset, not a new plugin or modified custom skill.

Oh My Pi reads the standard SKILL.md frontmatter from project .omp/skills; setup-omp.ps1 installs local copies. Read applicable skills on demand. RULES.md supplies this user's explicit workflow adaptations. No unavailable Codex Skill/Task/EnterWorktree/finishing command is required; use actual OMP/CLI equivalents and return for orchestrator review instead of integration options.
